name: Omberacetam (Noopept)

b.x: Does a 10 mg tablet really outperform 1,200 mg of piracetam? The 2009 Neznamov and Teleshova RCT [1] confirmed it did, producing superior MMSE improvements over 56 days in patients with mild cognitive disorders. Omberacetam (also sold as Noopept, chemical name N-phenylacetyl-L-prolylglycine ethyl ester, CAS 157115-85-0, designated GVS-111) is a synthetic dipeptide developed in Russia by the Zakusov Institute. After oral dosing, liver esterases rapidly convert it to cycloprolylglycine (CPG), the active metabolite with a seven-hour half-life that does most of the pharmacological work. CPG modulates both AMPA and NMDA glutamate receptors, boosting long-term potentiation in hippocampal circuits. The mechanism that separates omberacetam from older racetams is neurotrophin upregulation. Ostrovskaya's group confirmed BDNF and NGF increases in rat hippocampus [2]. That signal doesn't fade; expression continues rising with chronic dosing through day 56. Tens of thousands of users across r/Nootropics and Longecity forums report improved verbal fluency, memory recall, and a calmer quality of thought. The community figured out the choline problem before the researchers did. Without Alpha-GPC or CDP-choline, headaches are nearly guaranteed. Russia's Generium pharmaceutical company holds market authorization for 10 mg tablets. No Western regulatory body has approved or reviewed omberacetam. All published clinical data comes from Russian institutions with developer involvement.

After you swallow a 10 mg tablet, omberacetam hits peak plasma in about 15 minutes. It doesn't stay intact for long. Liver esterases cleave it into cycloprolylglycine (CPG), which carries a half-life of roughly seven hours and handles the sustained pharmacology. CPG binds to the glycine site on NMDA receptors and simultaneously modulates AMPA receptor trafficking. Both actions boost long-term potentiation, the molecular basis of memory formation in the hippocampus. The AMPA component speeds information processing; the NMDA component deepens encoding. Neurotrophin upregulation is the second pathway. Ostrovskaya's group [2] tracked BDNF and NGF expression in rat hippocampus during chronic dosing. Both growth factors increased progressively rather than plateauing. BDNF supports synaptic remodeling. NGF promotes cholinergic neuron survival, which is why omberacetam drains acetylcholine reserves and causes headaches without choline supplementation. A third mechanism runs through HIF-1 alpha activation. This transcription factor drives neuroprotective gene expression under oxidative stress. Pelsman's group [3] confirmed omberacetam blocked apoptosis in both normal and Down syndrome human cortical neurons exposed to oxidative challenge. The parent compound also inhibits calcium-mediated excitotoxicity and suppresses inflammatory cytokine release in CNS tissue [4]. Unlike piracetam, omberacetam achieves all of this at milligram doses because its lipophilicity gets it across the blood-brain barrier fast.
Omberacetam benefits center on memory, neuroprotection, and cognitive clarity at remarkably low doses.
Outperformed piracetam head-to-head on MMSE scores in Neznamov and Teleshova's 56-day RCT [1], at doses roughly 1,000x smaller by weight.
BDNF and NGF expression increases progressively with sustained dosing [2]. No plateau through day 56 in rat hippocampus.
Neuroprotection against amyloid-beta toxicity confirmed in cell models [5]. Reduces tau hyperphosphorylation and blocks apoptotic signaling.
Users across 500+ Reddit threads consistently report faster verbal fluency and word retrieval within 15 to 30 minutes of sublingual dosing.

The NA-831 Phase 2A trial (n=112, PMC11712949) tested CPG, the active metabolite, in Alzheimer's patients. The result: a 4.1-point ADAS-Cog-13 improvement over placebo. Conference-abstract level data only.
Mild anxiolytic effect without sedation, particularly at the 10 mg dose. Community reports describe reduced emotional reactivity under cognitive load.

Science & Community Aligned

Science and community converge on 10–30 mg/day range, 8-week cycling protocol, morning dosing, and choline co-supplementation. Community anecdotally confirms the BDNF/NGF gradual neuroplasticity timeline described in clinical literature. Primary divergence: community reports subjective tolerance in some users after 3–4 weeks while clinical trials did not document pharmacological tolerance; community increasingly prefers sublingual/intranasal while trials used oral only.

No reconstitution needed. Omberacetam comes as tablets (Generium brand, 10 mg) or research powder. If you're using powder, you need a milligram-accurate scale (0.001 g precision). Standard kitchen scales can't resolve 10 mg doses. The choline pairing isn't optional. Alpha-GPC 300 mg or CDP-choline 250 mg daily, starting the same day as omberacetam. This is the single most validated piece of community protocol wisdom for any nootropic. Some research-grade capsules contain 30 mg each. That's the entire Russian daily maximum in one capsule, three times the standard single dose. If you're using these, you need to open the capsule and weigh out 10 mg. Don't take a full capsule as your dose. Sublingual onset runs about 5 minutes versus 15 minutes oral. The practical difference in total duration is modest because CPG (the metabolite doing most of the work) lasts about seven hours either way. Sublingual is useful for pre-task acute effects; oral is fine for baseline cognitive support. Genuine Russian Generium-brand pharmaceutical tablets are also available as gray-market imports. These are GMP-manufactured with accurate 10 mg dosing per tablet. US research powder varies in quality. A Certificate of Analysis is the only record of what a batch contains.
Cycling Protocol

Russian clinical protocols use 56-day (8-week) treatment courses at 20 mg/day. A 4-week washout period is recommended between cycles. Chronic administration does not appear to cause tolerance: BDNF and NGF upregulation actually increases with sustained use. Some users run shorter 4-week cycles with 2-week breaks.
Omberacetam (Noopept) Cycle

The 8-week on / 4-week off cycle is derived directly from Russian clinical trial design (56-day treatment courses per Generium prescribing information), not from documented receptor desensitization, antibody formation, or hormonal axis effects. Animal and clinical data show BDNF/NGF upregulation does not diminish with continued use; true pharmacological tolerance is unlikely. Cycling is a precautionary convention based on trial methodology, designed to accommodate the minority of users who report subjective diminishing acute effects after 3–4 weeks of daily use.

Dosing tiers, timing, and cycle length
Choose your form: Generium 10 mg tablets (preferred for dose accuracy), research powder with a milligram scale, or research capsules (note the 30 mg capsule warning above).

Take 10 mg orally or sublingually in the morning, on an empty stomach or after a light meal. For sublingual, dissolve the tablet under your tongue for about 60 seconds. Onset is roughly 5 minutes sublingual, 15 minutes oral.
Take your choline supplement at the same time Alpha-GPC 300 mg or CDP-choline 250 mg, once daily.

If moving to the standard Russian clinical dose (intermediate protocol), add a second 10 mg dose at midday and a third in early afternoon. Never exceed 10 mg per individual dose or 30 mg per day total. At this frequency, increase choline to Alpha-GPC 300 to 600 mg or CDP-choline 500 mg daily.
Keep your last dose before 2 PM to avoid sleep disruption.
Run the cycle for 56 days (8 weeks) Then take a 4-week break before starting again. Up to three cycles per year follows Russian clinical practice.
Store tablets at room temperature (15 to 25 degrees Celsius) in a dry place away from direct light. No refrigeration needed.
Alternative Routes

10–30 mg/day; Tmax ~15 min; bioavailability of parent compound ~7–10% (oral first-pass) but CNS delivery is high due to lipophilicity and BBB penetration. Active metabolite CPG (t½ ~7h) provides sustained effect.

Sublingual

Same dose as oral (10–30 mg/day); Tmax ~5 min vs ~15 min oral; faster peak CNS delivery. Practical difference in total duration is modest since CPG metabolite (t½ ~7h) dominates sustained effect regardless of delivery route.

Tablet dissolved under tongue ~60 seconds, or powder in solution held sublingually. Faster onset appreciated by users seeking acute pre-task cognitive effect. No published human pharmacokinetic comparison of sublingual vs. oral routes for omberacetam specifically.
Intranasal

Community doses typically 1–10 mg intranasally; onset ~1–5 min; bypasses first-pass liver metabolism more completely than oral. Community reports heightened potency per mg vs. oral: some users use 5–10 mg intranasally where they would use 10 mg orally.

No published human pharmacokinetic data for intranasal omberacetam. Growing community preference for intranasal delivery as part of the full "Russian triple" stack (Semax + Selank + Noopept: all three dosed intranasally). Not pharmaceutical-grade.

Avoid
Other racetams (piracetam, aniracetam, oxiracetam)
Redundant glutamatergic mechanism. Co-use increases headache, irritability, and insomnia load without clear additive cognitive benefit at standard doses.
Cholinesterase inhibitors (donepezil, galantamine, rivastigmine)
Additive cholinergic potentiation risks excessive acetylcholine activity: GI distress, bradycardia, overstimulation. Mechanism directly conflicts with omberacetam-driven cholinergic demand.
CNS stimulants (modafinil, amphetamines, high-dose caffeine)
Additive excitatory effects increase insomnia, anxiety, and irritability risk. Community reports mood dysregulation with this combination, particularly in anxiety-prone users.
Alcohol
Counteracts neuroprotective CNS effects; conflicting CNS states (glutamatergic excitation vs. GABA/NMDA depression from alcohol) may worsen cognition and mood.

Psychiatric adverse effects deserve attention first. A case series (PMC4756795) documented four patients who developed new-onset anxiety disorder or mania attributed to omberacetam. That number is small, but the severity is real. Anyone with personal or family psychiatric history should approach this compound cautiously and monitor mood weekly. Headache is the most common complaint, and it's almost entirely preventable. Omberacetam upregulates acetylcholine receptor activity, which depletes choline stores. Without supplemental Alpha-GPC (300 mg) or CDP-choline (250 mg), headaches typically appear within one to two hours of dosing. The community calls this predictable. Add choline on day one; don't wait for the headache. Paradoxical brain fog at higher single doses is a well-documented finding. Taking 20 mg or more in a single dose can produce the exact cognitive impairment you're trying to fix. The pharmacology supports this; NMDA modulation has an inverted-U dose-response curve. If you experience mental haziness, drop back to 10 mg. More is genuinely not better with this compound. Insomnia and vivid dreams show up when dosing runs past early afternoon. CPG has a seven-hour half-life, so a 2 PM dose is still active at 9 PM. Sublingual delivery in the afternoon is particularly disruptive to sleep because onset is faster and peak CNS levels run higher. Irritability and restlessness occur in a subset of users, especially when stacking with stimulants like modafinil or high-dose caffeine. Dropping the stimulant usually resolves it. Occasional GI discomfort has been reported but rarely leads to discontinuation. Rare blood pressure elevation warrants monitoring in anyone with borderline or uncontrolled hypertension. The Russian prescribing information lists this. The LD50 in rats exceeds 2,000 mg/kg oral, which is roughly 100 times the therapeutic dose. Acute toxicity risk at standard doses is low. Contraindications: pregnancy or breastfeeding (no safety data), known hypersensitivity to racetam-class compounds, severe hepatic impairment, severe renal impairment, children under 18, and uncontrolled hypertension. When to stop and seek medical attention: new-onset anxiety that doesn't resolve within a few days of dose reduction, any hypomanic or manic symptoms, persistent insomnia despite morning-only dosing, or headaches that don't respond to choline supplementation.
Common Issues & Solutions

Headache within 1–2 hours of dosing: almost always choline deficiency: add Alpha-GPC 300 mg or CDP-choline 250 mg daily; headaches typically resolve within 24–48 hours. This is the #1 fixable complaint.

Paradoxical brain fog or confusion at higher single doses (>15–20 mg): reduce to 10 mg and do not titrate above 10 mg per dose: more is not better with omberacetam. A well-documented community and pharmacological finding.

Diminishing acute cognitive effects after 3–4 weeks of continuous daily use: implement 5-day-on/2-day-off micro-cycling within the active phase, or shift from 3× daily to 1–2× daily; full 4-week washout restores response for the next cycle.

Insomnia or vivid dreams: ensure last dose is no later than 1–2 PM; if persisting, shift to morning-only single dose. Sublingual delivery in the afternoon is particularly likely to cause sleep disruption.

Anxiety, irritability, or mood disturbance: reduce dose to 10 mg once daily and remove all stimulant co-administration; if psychiatric symptoms persist or escalate (anxiety disorder, hypomania, mania), discontinue immediately: 4 documented cases in PMC4756795.

Omberacetam holds market authorization in Russia through Generium Pharmaceutical as a prescription nootropic for mild cognitive disorders of vascular and traumatic origin. The approved regimen is 10 mg up to three times daily for 56-day courses. No FDA approval exists for any indication. The FDA has issued an import alert treating omberacetam (Noopept) as an unapproved drug, which means US customs can seize imported shipments. It is not a scheduled substance under the Controlled Substances Act. Possession is legal in the US, but it cannot be sold as a dietary supplement or drug. Omberacetam powder and capsules are sold online labeled "for research purposes only." Genuine Russian pharmaceutical tablets also circulate as imports, which is a gray-market pathway. Athletes should verify WADA status. Nootropics are not specifically listed on the WADA prohibited list, but novel psychoactive substances fall under a monitored category. Military personnel on expanded drug panels should confirm clearance with their command. This content is for educational and informational purposes only. It does not constitute medical advice. Consult a licensed healthcare provider before using any compound.

faqs.q: Why does Noopept give me headaches?
faqs.a: It increases acetylcholine receptor activity, and if your choline stores are already low (common if you're not eating eggs, liver, or meat), your brain draws down reserves and headaches follow. The fix is simple: add Alpha-GPC 300 mg or CDP-choline 250 mg daily. Most people report headaches stop within a day or two.

Clinical evidence suggests no: BDNF and NGF upregulation actually increases with sustained use. Community experience is more mixed, with some users reporting reduced acute effects after 3-4 weeks while maintaining baseline cognitive improvements. The Russian cycling recommendation (8 weeks on, 4 off) is based on clinical trial design, not documented tolerance.

faqs.q: What's the difference between taking Noopept orally vs sublingually?
faqs.a: Sublingual hits peak plasma in about 5 minutes vs 15 minutes oral. Since the parent compound only lasts about 20 minutes in plasma, sublingual gets more to the brain faster. But the active metabolite CPG has a 7-hour half-life, so the practical difference in duration is less dramatic than the onset difference.

faqs.q: Is 30 mg/day really the maximum dose?
faqs.a: Yes: that's the Russian approved maximum from the prescribing information (10 mg up to 3x daily). Going above 30 mg/day isn't supported by any clinical data. Stick to this ceiling.

faqs.q: Will Noopept show up on a drug test?
faqs.a: Not on standard workplace panels (SAMHSA-5). It's not a scheduled substance in the US, though the FDA has issued an import alert treating it as an unapproved drug. Military members should verify their specific panel requirements since some expanded tests screen for novel psychoactive substances.

faqs.q: Does Omberacetam (Noopept) need to be reconstituted?
faqs.a: No. Omberacetam (Noopept) is taken by mouth and is not reconstituted with bacteriostatic water.

faqs.q: What is the half-life of Omberacetam (Noopept)?
faqs.a: The half-life of Omberacetam (Noopept) is ~15-20 min (plasma); active metabolite CPG persists longer. This determines how frequently you need to dose for consistent blood levels.
